pages.text: It carries six animals: cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, goats, horses, llamas... (not tamed pets).$(br2)$(li)$(l)Lead$() animals up to it and click it: as many as there's room for go in, and you get the leads back.$(li)$(l)Sneak-click$() it empty-handed to let them all out beside you.$(br2)Aboard, they come to no harm. People can't ride in it.

A $(l:freight/wagon_loader)wagon loader$(/l) works with it too: loading, it puts the animals standing around it into the train's livestock wagons; unloading, it lets them out behind it. So a timetabled train can take the sheep from the farm to market by itself.
Loaded from the pen behind the wagon loader.
